items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I believe it was the Harlem Highlenders that's where I met Snags Allen

ctx.x: Well I had just got the Highlanders -- this one I called the Rocking Highlanders. I tried to revive the other thing, because we were just about as near -- we didn't have the good dancers because 'cause Baby Laurence was one of the greatest dancers in the world -- was among those guys.
Did Snags Allen know that you were reviving that?

I'm quite sure -- everybody know. Yeah once it got started. So we revived it in Cleveland then we went to Detroit -- and where the hell else did we go? -- I think we went up Canada -- I'm not sure -- I'm quite sure we went to Canada, and Baltimore, and then all the theaters -- Washington, the Howard Theater.
